title: Insan Degree College — Official Institutional Web Portal

solution: Built a high-performance, mobile-optimized official college web portal with dynamic notice boards, faculty profiles, department curricula, and an admissions inquiry engine.
metric: Over 25,000 monthly portal visits during admission season with zero downtime

title: Ali Public School — Campus Management Portal
problem: School administration relied on manual registers for student admissions, class section distribution, fee collection vouchers, and academic term marks.
solution: Delivered a clean school management portal consolidating student records, automated fee voucher generation, syllabus schedules, and parent communication channels.
metric: Administrative overhead reduced by 65%; eliminated lost fee receipts

title: Central Medical — Clinical OPD & Healthcare Portal
problem: Front-desk staff handling telephone bookings suffered double-booked consultation slots across specialist doctors, creating long patient waiting queues.
solution: Architected a multi-specialist clinical OPD booking engine with atomic reservation locks, doctor duty calendars, patient history lookup, and automated confirmations.
metric: Zero patient double-bookings; average front-desk waiting time dropped by 50%

title: Wheelcraft — Automotive Wheels & Fitment Platform
problem: Automotive distributor struggled to present complex multi-vehicle wheel fitment specifications, alloy finishes, and wholesale pricing tiers to dealers and workshops.
solution: Engineered a high-speed automotive catalog platform with car make/model fitment lookup, rim specification filtering, and quick WhatsApp/commercial inquiry dispatch.
metric: Inquiry-to-quote conversion increased by 85% via one-click vehicle fitment lookup

title: Tender Appliances — Home & Kitchen Commercial Commerce
problem: Fast-moving kitchen appliances enterprise required a mobile-first online storefront with automated GST tax invoices, reliable payment gateways, and real-time inventory counts.
solution: Built a clean, frictionless direct-to-consumer and B2B ordering store with automated GST calculation, integrated payment workflows, and shipping updates.
metric: 3.2x faster checkout turnaround with zero inventory over-allocation

title: ATA Publications Kolkata — Publishing & Distribution Engine
problem: Prestigious Kolkata publishing house relied on regional offline bookstores and telephone queries, making it difficult for national readers and libraries to discover and purchase books.
solution: Developed an elegant online book catalog and order dispatch system with ISBN lookups, author indexes, categorized book previews, and pan-India checkout.
metric: Expanded reader reach nationwide; direct book sales increased by over 140%

problem: Early childhood education brand needed an interactive, cheerful digital presence to communicate its specialized curriculum and generate qualified franchise and parent inquiries.

metric: Parent tour bookings tripled within the first quarter of deployment

title: Imaan360 — Global Islamic Lifestyle & Community PWA
problem: Native app stores imposed high install barriers, and users in low-bandwidth areas suffered network timeouts while attempting to calculate prayer times and Qibla bearings.
solution: Engineered a lightweight Progressive Web App using Service Workers, IndexedDB, and client-side astronomical calculation algorithms for seamless offline access.
metric: 50,000+ active global users with sub-100ms load times and 100% offline capability

title: V3A — Enterprise Workflow & Systems Architecture Portal
problem: Engineering and infrastructure teams needed a unified, secure portal for monitoring internal project stages, deployment status, and customer service delivery milestones.
solution: Engineered a protected enterprise operational portal with granular role permissions, real-time status feeds, automated activity logs, and system health checks.
metric: Eliminated internal coordination bottlenecks across multi-project engineering sprints

title: ApexDental — Multi-Doctor Clinic Appointment & Slot Lock Portal
problem: Dental clinics lose 20-30% of billable chair time to overlapping phone bookings, unconfirmed cancellations, and front-desk reception bottlenecks during peak morning consultations.
solution: Delivered an automated, patient-friendly clinic appointment portal with doctor specialization filtering, dynamic chair slot locks, digital token passes, and automated WhatsApp/SMS schedule reminders.
metric: Wait times reduced by 40% with a 98.7% verified patient arrival rate across 3 clinic branches

title: LuxeStudio — Hair Salon Stylist & Chair Scheduling Platform
problem: Hair stylists and salons faced chaotic walk-in traffic, erratic calendar coordination, and empty chairs on weekday mornings contrasting with chaotic weekend delays.

metric: Increased weekday chair utilization by 42% and automated client re-booking cycles via WhatsApp

title: GlowSpa & Beauty Parlour — Esthetician & Treatment Reservation Engine
problem: High-end beauty parlours lost thousands in revenue each month from last-minute cancellations on custom aesthetic packages (bridal makeup, skincare therapies, nail spa) without deposit tracking.
solution: Developed an elegant, high-conversion reservation portal featuring modular treatment packages, esthetician schedules, instant slot reservation, and automated deposit receipt generation.
metric: Completely eliminated no-shows on bridal/premium packages and scaled to over 10,000 booked sessions

title: BistroTable — Fine Dining Table Reservation & Pre-Order System

solution: Built an interactive restaurant table reservation portal with live floor plan selection (Patio, Main Dining, VIP Lounge), party size filters, pre-order dish selections, and automatic WhatsApp confirmations.
metric: Boosted peak weekend table turnover velocity by 2.3x with 99.4% table occupancy and zero overbooking
